en.title: Optimal Vehicle Load Distribution After Adding Packages
en.description:
Add all P indivisible packages to the existing n vehicles; a vehicle may receive 0, and original packages cannot be removed. Minimize the final maximum vehicle load. Output any optimal final load array; the distribution need not be unique.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n P, and the second line contains n original loads. The original gives no value bounds; this site sets 1≤n≤100000, 0≤P≤10^12, 0≤(original load)≤10^9.
en.output: Output exactly n non-negative integers, any optimal final load distribution.
en.explanation: Example 1: you can output 3 3, adding 2 and 1, for 3 added in total; the maximum 3 is optimal. Example 2: nothing is added, so output 5 0. Example 3: you can output 1 1 0; putting 1 on any two different vehicles is also a correct answer.
hints: The optimal cap C is the larger of the original maximum and the total load averaged and rounded up. Fill each vehicle up to C in input order as far as possible, until the added packages run out.
